research.thaumaturge.focus_advanced.stag: A Lesser Focus knows the elements of an instruction but struggles with relationships between them. The occult correspondence described in Names and Natures suggests a remedy. I shall refine a Lesser Focus at the Arcane Workbench and see whether an Advanced Focus can preserve a more intricate expression.

The Advanced Focus accommodates Structured Arcane Syntax and a greater native complexity. Its revised recipe is recorded here and in Names and Natures. I confess I am pleased that the apparatus is finally keeping pace with my experiments.
research.thaumaturge.focus_greater.stage: My Advanced Focus has become the limiting factor, rather than my understanding—or so I sincerely hope. Infused Syntax describes a procedure using Arcane Infusion and concentrated correspondences to prepare a Greater Focus. I intend to follow it precisely. This time.

The Greater Focus supports Infused Arcane Syntax and the highest native complexity of these foci. Runic Mastery records the vocabulary now available. I had expected a satisfactory conclusion. Instead I find I have acquired a rather more ambitious set of questions.
